== Notes ==
* [[Creature]]s affected by the shroud can still cast enchantments that do not require targeting (e.g. [[Shadow Form]] or [[Conjure Flame]]).
* Foes with this hex cannot be targeted by [[Enchantment spell#Characteristics|enchantment spells that target a foe]], like [[Ice Spear]].
